Messages.Author: Salem
Messages.Body:
I did a quick search on Mata and jack of both sides, Mata and pier, Mata
and magic, Mata and concealed. None of them gave me anything.

So I was wondering, does Mata Hari's ability allow her to get cards
using her ability when the card she wants isn't played in the normal
manner? (eg: Pier 13, Magic of the Smith, Jack of Both Sides, etc.)

After some musings my playgroup was thinking 'no', as the cards brought
into play by these other cards are not "played" in the normal manner,
and Mata only allows her to *play* (read: played from hand) cards that
she wouldn't otherwise be able to play.

Confirm/deny?

--
salem

this is a card played by another card. setting up this trichotemy in
the actual rules seems appropriate, and not too long-winded.

hasn't paid only 1 for it? this should now be incorrect? or am i
missing something? i will hit this thread again when i come home and
